/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, math
expr=pd.read_csv('sample.swap.rna.q2.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',index_col=0)
markers=pd.read_csv('wheatomics_markers.tsv',sep='\\t')
mapc={'Root cap':'root_cap','Cortex':'cortex','Epidermis':'epidermis','Provascular cells':'provascular','Phloem':'phloem','Endodermis':'endodermis','Xylem':'xylem'}
markers['expected']=markers['cluster'].map(mapc)
markers=markers.drop_duplicates(['gene','expected'])
markers=markers[markers.gene.isin(expr.index)]
print('markers present', markers.shape[0])
# Per cluster: mean log1p expression by column; zscore per gene across cols then average
log=np.log1p(expr)
z=log.sub(log.mean(axis=1),axis=0).div(log.std(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan),axis=0)
for exp, sub in markers.groupby('expected'):
    genes=sub.gene.tolist()
    print('\\nCLUSTER',exp,'n',len(genes))
    mean_expr=expr.loc[genes].mean(axis=0).sort_values(ascending=False)
    print('mean raw top', ', '.join(f'{k}:{v:.1f}' for k,v in mean_expr.items()))
    mean_z=z.loc[genes].mean(axis=0).sort_values(ascending=False)
    print('mean z   top', ', '.join(f'{k}:{v:.2f}' for k,v in mean_z.items()))
    # count marker genes whose max column is each
    maxcols=expr.loc[genes].idxmax(axis=1)
    print('max count', maxcols.value_counts().to_dict())
    # list genes not max in expected
    bad=[]
    for g in genes:
        row=expr.loc[g].sort_values(ascending=False)
        bad.append((g,row.index[0],row.iloc[0], expr.loc[g,exp], row.index[1], row.iloc[1]))
    for g,top,topv,ev,sec,secv in bad:
        flag='*' if top"'!=exp else '"' '
        print(flag,g,'top',top,topv,'expected',ev,'2nd',sec,secv)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, re
expr=pd.read_csv('sample.swap.rna.q2.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',index_col=0)
s4=pd.read_excel('PMC11860762/mmc5.xlsx', sheet_name='Table S4')
s4['cluster']=s4['cluster'].str.strip()
# zscore log expression per gene
log=np.log1p(expr)
z=log.sub(log.mean(axis=1),axis=0).div(log.std(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan),axis=0)
# expected mapping for clusters to matrix labels; G1/S and G2/M -> meristems, unknown ignored
mapc={
 '1 - Epidermis':'epidermis','7 - Epidermis':'epidermis','2 - Cortex':'cortex','4 - Provascular Cells':'provascular','6 - Pericycle':'pericycle','8 - Root Hair':'root_hair','9 - Endodermis':'endodermis','10 - Xylem':'xylem','11 - Endodermis/Phloem':None,'13 - Phloem':'phloem','14 - Root Cap':'root_cap','3 - G1/S':'meristems','12 - G2/M':'meristems'}
print('cluster\\tn\\texpected\\ttop_by_mean_z\\tmean_z_by_col\\tmax_count')
for c,sub in s4.groupby('cluster',sort=False):
    genes=[g for g in sub.Gene_ID.dropna().astype(str).unique() if g in expr.index]
    if not genes: continue
    # score all DEGs weighted by avg_log2FC? top 100? output for all and top50
    for label,genes2 in [('all',genes),('top50',[g for g in sub.sort_values('avg_log2FC',ascending=False).Gene_ID.astype(str).unique() if g in expr.index][:50]),('top20',[g for g in sub.sort_values('avg_log2FC',ascending=False).Gene_ID.astype(str).unique() if g in expr.index][:20])]:
        mean_z=z.loc[genes2].mean(axis=0).sort_values(ascending=False)
        maxcnt=expr.loc[genes2].idxmax(axis=1).value_counts().to_dict()
        print(f'{c} [{label}]\\t{len(genes2)}\\t{mapc.get(c)}\\t{mean_z.index[0]}\\t'+', '.join(f'{k}:{v:.2f}' for k,v in mean_z.items())+'\\t'+str(maxcnt))
    print()
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, urllib.parse, subprocess, json, re, html
expr=pd.read_csv('sample.swap.rna.q2.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',index_col=0)
cols=['meristems','pericycle','root_hair','epidermis']
genes=[]
for col in cols:
    vals=expr[col]
    score=(vals+1)/(expr.drop(columns=[col]).mean(axis=1)+1)
    top=score[vals>5].sort_values(ascending=False).head(8).index.tolist()
    print(col, top)
    genes+=top
# Also S4 top G1S/G2M
s4=pd.read_excel('PMC11860762/mmc5.xlsx', sheet_name='Table S4')
for cl in ['3 - G1/S','12 - G2/M']:
    top=s4[s4.cluster.str.strip()==cl].sort_values('avg_log2FC',ascending=False).Gene_ID.astype(str).head(8).tolist()
    print(cl, top)
    genes+=top
genes=list(dict.fromkeys(genes))
open('query_genes.txt','w').write(','.join(genes))
print(len(genes))
PY
GENES="'$(cat query_genes.txt)
curl -s -L -X POST '"'https://wheatomics.sdau.edu.cn/scRNA/?genome=Chinese_Spring#results' -F 'genome=Chinese_Spring' -F \"gene="'$GENES" -o scRNA_ambig.html
python3 - <<'"'PY'
import re,json,pandas as pd
s=open('scRNA_ambig.html').read()
m=re.search(r'window\\.__dotplotRows_dotplot_root = (\\[.*?\\]);',s,re.S)
print('found', bool(m))
rows=json.loads(m.group(1))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
# for each gene top cluster by scaled and avg
for g,sub in df.groupby('gene'):
    top=sub.sort_values('avg_exp_scaled',ascending=False).iloc[:3]
    print(g, ' | '.join(f\"{r.cluster}:{r.avg_exp_scaled:.2f}/{r.avg_exp:.2f}\" for _,r in top.iterrows()))
PY"
